The page reports observed HGAB allocations. A missing comparable baseline cannot establish unchanged budgets or insertions.

NEP comparison coverage

A comparable NEP school-level baseline has not been constructed and reconciled. NEP-to-HGAB changes, insertions and removals are therefore not established. These are school operating allocations, not school-building construction projects. The HGAB total covers the extracted schedule fields only; it is not the entire DepEd budget.

Methodology and source limits

Source occurrences and their printed allocation fields are retained. Amounts are proposals, not payments or losses. A missing baseline is represented by an explicit status, not numeric zero. Source PDF page references come from the current candidate extraction and require original-page scope review. Graphs show the first 12 filtered rows; CSV exports all filtered rows.
